name: BDX
summary: BDX is proposed downstream of the Jefferson Lab Hall A beam dump in Newport News, Virginia. It is a dedicated electron-beam-dump dark-matter experiment, including the MINI validation phase.
detection_principle: Electrons in a thick target produce dark-sector particles while ordinary particles are shielded. A downstream calorimeter seeks dark-matter–electron scattering, with outer vetoes and shielding suppressing backgrounds.

results.summary: BDX-MINI published its 2019–2020 dark-matter search; expected sensitivity of full BDX is presented separately.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
